overview_description.description: Amboras offers an AI-native ecommerce platform that builds, operates, and optimizes online stores. The platform generates complete storefronts, including layout, branding, product pages, and checkout, from simple text prompts and product data. It includes an AI-driven shop system for managing inventory, orders, and fulfillment, as well as tools for AI SEO, reviews, AI-generated transactional and marketing emails, and built-in analytics. Amboras also provides agentic A/B testing that creates and runs experiments on copy, layout, pricing, and bundles, promoting winning variants automatically. First-party analytics and real-time event tracking are integrated directly into the store backend. The service is designed for merchants who want an all-in-one system to launch new stores, migrate existing stores, and manage day-to-day ecommerce operations with AI assistance.

product.name: Amboras Platform
product.description: Amboras Platform is an AI-native ecommerce system that builds, manages, and optimizes online stores with integrated checkout, analytics, and automation.

product.name: AI SEO
product.description: AI SEO generates and maintains structured metadata, schema, and copy for ecommerce pages based on live search performance.

product.name: Agentic A/B testing
product.description: Agentic A/B testing automatically generates, runs, and promotes winning store variants using sequential Bayesian experiments.

product.name: Analytics
product.description: Analytics provides real-time, first-party storefront metrics including sessions, funnels, geo data, and event streams.

product.name: AI emails
product.description: AI emails manages transactional and event-driven email templates that trigger automatically on store events with optional AI-generated copy.

product.name: Reviews
product.description: Reviews collects, moderates, and displays product reviews and powers review-request workflows for Amboras stores.
